drift_observation: Yes, systematic downward drift exists between original_curated and the 2026-05-13 new-wave concerns. Overall: original HIGH=47.9% vs strict_in_scope HIGH=30.7% (drop of 17.2pp); MEDIUM rises from 41.0% to 58.7%. Most pronounced in 'reporting' (HIGH 29.3% original -> 0% strict; MEDIUM 53.4% -> 95.0%) and 'evaluation_metrics' (HIGH 53.9% -> 25.8%). External_validation also drops (HIGH 75.9% -> 56.3%). Conclusion: new-wave extraction agents systematically grade severity one notch lower than the curated baseline for the same kind of issue. Recommend either re-scoring new-wave concerns or re-anchoring the original baseline; current state will skew any RAG severity-aware retrieval. Note: permissive_out_of_scope is in between (HIGH 41.3%, MEDIUM 55.6%), consistent with a milder rubric overall, not a category-specific artifact.
